summary: --- name: core-format-and-structure description: OpenAPI/Swagger 2.0 document format, file structure, and data types --- # Format and Structure (Swagger 2.0) Swagger 2.0 specs are JSON or YAML. Field names are **case sensitive**. The spec uses fixed fields (declared names) and patterned fields (regex for names, e.g. path keys, `^x-` extensions). ## File structure - Single file by default; convention is `swagger.json`. - Parts can be split via `$ref` (JSON Schema style). Only canonical dereferencing is supported for `$ref`. ## Data types
